description: For a nonzero limit ordinal a and a subset of its small representative, cofinality is equivalent to the supremum of its ordinal positions being a.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Cofinality.cofinal_iff_sup.{u} (a : Ordinal.{u}) (ha : Order.IsSuccLimit a) (s : Set a.ToType) :
  IsCofinal s ↔ ⨆ x, ↑(↑x).toOrd = a
